cases.title: Warehouse staff can prepare a XianGuanJia shipment from scans and OCR
cases.actor: Authorized warehouse staff user with rental:xianyu:ship permission
cases.user_goal: Bind an assigned rental device to a pending XianGuanJia order and submit shipment after confirming the waybill OCR draft.
preconditions: Backend runtime is available with tenant 1 and an authorized XianGuanJia shop.
The staff app has a valid login token and tenant id.
There is one ASSIGNED device assignment linked to a pending channel order.
XianGuanJia write switch is enabled only for the controlled test shop.
steps: Scan or upload a waybill label image and confirm or correct the OCR draft.
Scan the signed device QR and verify the resolved device number.
Search pending shipment orders and select the matching order.
Confirm the final shipment dialog and submit.
expected_results: The page renders waybill OCR, device scan, order search, and shipment confirmation sections.
Submit remains disabled until order, device, express company, and waybill fields are complete.
A successful controlled submission records source STAFF and returns a masked waybill.
Failures for write-disabled, unauthorized shop, invalid device, and remote errors leave local assignment state unchanged.
boundary_cases: Write switch disabled emits no remote ship call.
Unauthorized shop emits no remote ship call.
Repeated idempotency key returns the original successful result.
Backend unavailable must not render a blank page.
